proposal.reason: Main change is a new independent TROCE GIN backend, including GIN plugin registration, GIN host/device context lifecycle, GIN device API extensions (SignalSet, backend type/version), and TROCE-specific GIN queueing/completion logic. Added network because the PR also makes substantive shared net_ib transport changes (provider detection/type plumbing, QP inline behavior, opcode/signal handling in IB proxy/connect paths) that affect core network transport behavior beyond a pure local rename or test/doc edit.
